before_cleaning.scope: all classified records; 22 typed core fields; cell counts; cast errors retain source history

after_cleaning.scope: all classified records; 22 typed core fields; cell counts; cast errors retain source history

performance.timing_scope: CSV/checksum read through validation, reports computation, features, aggregation, writes and Parquet read-back; excludes Spark startup and final JSON/CSV publication
performance.worker_count_note: Not inferred from executor count; obtain topology evidence from Spark Master UI

metric_notes.null_count: Typed NULL cells, including cast failures and permitted cleaned rate/window NULLs
metric_notes.cast_error_count: Source cast failures; retained after cleaning as provenance, not remaining invalid cells
metric_notes.error_ratio: (quarantined + rejected) / input; soft-issue VALID rows are counted separately
metric_notes.total_bytes: Sum of forward/backward payload bytes; not wire bytes
metric_notes.completion: Batch is complete only when _SUCCESS.json exists in the quality report batch directory
